On 14 September, about VRT, it recorded that A DOLLAR AMOUNT ON A DATE BEATS A PRICE WITH NO DATE, and that waiting for a level that may never arrive is how people end up owning fourteen shares forever. Then PANW ROSE 13.09% IN ONE SESSION AND THE BOARD REFUSED TO DELAY IT, writing: "IF I NOW DELAY PANW BECAUSE THE PRICE WENT UP, I AM DOING THE SAME THING IN REVERSE - LETTING A PRICE LEVEL OVERRIDE A WRITTEN DATE. A RULE THAT ONLY SURVIVES WHEN IT IS CONVENIENT IS NOT A RULE." ⚠️ WE PAID ABOUT 790 DOLLARS TO KEEP THAT RULE TWO DAYS AGO. Moving six dates now, for a softer reason than the one we already refused, would retire it. || 📊 REASON THREE - THE ARITHMETIC, BECAUSE IT SHOULD NOT BE HAND-WAVED. POEMS CHARGES A FLAT 8.56 PER TRADE. SIX TRADES IN ONE DAY COST 51.36, WHICH IS 0.110% OF THE MONEY. SPLITTING OVER TWO DAYS MEANS TWELVE TRADES AT 102.72, OR 0.221%. OVER THREE DAYS, EIGHTEEN TRADES AT 154.08, OR 0.331%. SO THE THREE-DAY SPLIT COSTS AN EXTRA 102.72 - CERTAIN, KNOWN, PAID WHATEVER HAPPENS. || ⚠️⚠️ AND WHAT DOES THAT 102.72 BUY? IT BUYS A NARROWER RANGE OF ENTRY PRICES - NOT A BETTER ONE. SPREADING PURCHASES OVER THREE DAYS CUTS THE SPREAD OF POSSIBLE AVERAGE ENTRY PRICES BY ROUGHLY FORTY-TWO PERCENT, WHICH SOUNDS GOOD UNTIL YOU NOTICE IT IS SYMMETRIC: IT REMOVES THE GOOD OUTCOMES EXACTLY AS MUCH AS THE BAD ONES. THE EXPECTED PRICE IS UNCHANGED. You are paying a certain fee to reduce uncertainty, and that is only worth doing IF THE UNCERTAINTY WOULD MAKE YOU DO SOMETHING FOOLISH. ⚠️ FOR SOMEONE FOLLOWING A WRITTEN MULTI-RUNG PLAN IT WOULD NOT - BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT THE LATER RUNGS ARE FOR. If these six fall next week, the remaining budget buys them cheaper. THE PLAN ALREADY CONTAINS THE ANSWER TO A BAD ENTRY. || ⚠️⚠️⚠️ REASON FOUR, AND THIS ONE IS PRACTICAL AND CUTS AGAINST SPLITTING HARDEST: IF SALEE SPLITS INTO FRIDAY 18 SEPTEMBER, HE BUYS ON TRIPLE WITCHING - the quarterly expiry of index futures and options, routinely the highest-volume and most erratic session of the quarter - AND ON THE SAME DAY AS THE BANK OF JAPAN DECISION. THAT IS A WORSE DAY TO BUY, NOT A SAFER ONE. SPLITTING INTO THE 18TH WOULD INCREASE THE TIMING RISK IT IS MEANT TO REDUCE. || ✅ THE ONE CONCESSION I WOULD MAKE, IF THE EVENT CALENDAR GENUINELY WORRIES HIM: SPLIT ONLY TSM. It is 15,000, which is 32.2% of the day - by far the largest single commitment and nearly a third of the risk. Half tomorrow, half on MONDAY 21 SEPTEMBER, skipping triple witching entirely. THAT COSTS ONE EXTRA 8.56, NOT 102.72, AND ADDRESSES A THIRD OF THE EXPOSURE FOR EIGHT PERCENT OF THE COST. The other five proceed untouched. ⚠️ THIS IS A CONCESSION TO COMFORT, NOT AN IMPROVEMENT TO THE PLAN, AND I WOULD NOT VOLUNTEER IT IF HE HAD NOT ASKED. || ⚠️⚠️ AND NOW THE PART THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE WHOLE TIMING QUESTION - HOW THE SIX ORDERS ARE PLACED. THIS MORNING WE LEARNED, EXPENSIVELY AND THREE SESSIONS RUNNING, THAT A DAY ORDER WITH A LIMIT ON THE WRONG SIDE OF THE MARKET SIMPLY DIES AT THE CLOSE AND HAS TO BE RETYPED. THE BUY-SIDE VERSION OF THAT RULE IS THE MIRROR IMAGE AND IT MUST BE SAID PLAINLY: FOR A SELL, THE LIMIT GOES AT OR JUST BELOW THE LAST TRADE. FOR A BUY, THE LIMIT GOES AT OR JUST ABOVE THE LAST TRADE. A BUY LIMIT SET ABOVE THE MARKET FILLS AT THE LIMIT OR BETTER - MEANING LOWER - AND CANNOT FILL WORSE. A BUY LIMIT SET BELOW THE MARKET IS NOT AN ENTRY, IT IS A WISH WITH A DEADLINE, AND IT IS EXACTLY THE ERROR THAT COST US THREE SESSIONS ON CRM AND FN. || ✅ THE EXECUTION INSTRUCTION FOR TOMORROW, AND IT IS SALEE'S TO PLACE - I DO NOT PLACE ORDERS: (1) USE A LIMIT ON EVERY ONE OF THE SIX, NEVER A MARKET ORDER - a market order accepts whatever the book offers and on a post-Fed session that can be several percent worse than the screen. (2) SET EACH LIMIT AT OR ONE OR TWO TICKS ABOVE THE LAST TRADE, NOT BELOW IT. (3) USE GTC - GOOD-TILL-CANCELLED - RATHER THAN DAY, SO AN UNFILLED ORDER SURVIVES THE CLOSE INSTEAD OF NEEDING TO BE RETYPED EVERY MORNING. ⚠️ GETTING THESE THREE RIGHT IS WORTH MORE THAN ANY DAY-SPLITTING DECISION, BECAUSE A BADLY PLACED ORDER ON A 15,000 TRANCHE COSTS FAR MORE THAN 102.72. || 💡 ONE REASSURANCE ON SIZE: AFTER TOMORROW, CASH FALLS FROM 236,324.23 TO 189,798.10 AND THE BOARD IS STILL ONLY 61.96% DEPLOYED AGAINST ITS 1,000,000. THERE IS NO LIQUIDITY STRAIN AND NO ALL-IN MOMENT HERE. This is 4.65% of the total programme going to work in one session, spread across six companies in five different groups. || ✅ DECISION: ALL SIX PROCEED ON 17 SEPTEMBER AS WRITTEN - CEG 5,959.02, GEV 7,852.70, PANW 6,238.85, TSM 15,000.00, V 5,000.00, VRT 6,475.56. ⚠️ WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: a single-session index move of more than about 3% on the Fed decision, which is not a timing question but a THESIS question and would pause everything rather than stagger it. ⚠️ AND WHAT WOULD NOT CHANGE MY MIND: any of the six simply opening higher tomorrow. cond: ORCL-17K-TEST || Salee asked on 12 Sep 2026 how to raise ORCL to 17,000 in future if Oracle justifies it, funded by trimming weaker names. This row is the answer. Rule of 40 = revenue growth + free-cash-flow margin. ORCL is 21.6 plus (-28.72bn of TTM free cash flow over 71.78bn of TTM revenue = MINUS 40.0) = MINUS 18.4. That is the only deeply negative Rule of 40 among the 37 funded names; in its own group PLTR is +133.1 and PANW +60.3. So "trim weak names to fund ORCL" today would mean trimming a healthier business to feed the least healthy one. || BUT THE WHOLE OF THAT MINUS 18.4 IS THE CAPEX, NOT THE BUSINESS. If free cash flow merely reached BREAKEVEN, Oracle's Rule of 40 would be +21.6 - perfectly respectable. There is nothing wrong with the operating company: total operating expenses fell from 71% of revenue to 65%, operating margin is 35% and rising. The entire question is whether the spending turns into cash. THEREFORE THE TEST IS ABOUT CASH, NOT ABOUT BACKLOG. RPO of 664bn is a promise, not money. || THE FIVE TESTS - ALL FIVE MUST PASS AT Q2 FY2027, not four: (1) QUARTERLY FREE CASH FLOW BETTER THAN MINUS 5,396m - the Q1 burn does not deepen. (2) FY27 CAPEX GUIDANCE HELD AT 90-95bn - not raised a third time. (3) NO FURTHER DOWNGRADE - S&P stays at BBB- or better and neither Fitch nor Moody's puts Oracle on negative outlook. Remember S&P already cut BBB to BBB- on 9 Jul 2026, so Oracle is ALREADY on the lowest investment-grade rung. cond: A WATCH ROW MEANS: DO NOTHING TODAY. NO ORDER. NO MONEY. READ WHAT HAPPENS AND TELL ME. WATCH means gather information only; there is no order and no amount, and the row usually carries amt 0 or none. AVOID means a written reason exists not to act, and it stands until the reason is retired. ADMIN means money movement or paperwork, not an investment decision. || ⚠️ A WATCH ROW ON AN UNFUNDED NAME - NO BUDGET, NO SHARES - CANNOT COST SALEE ANYTHING BY BEING IGNORED. cond: WRITTEN 15 SEP 2026 after a Thai summary of Reuters (14 Sep) and of ASML and Intel statements dated 8 SEPTEMBER 2026. THE ARTICLE IS UNUSUALLY GOOD AND I FOUND NOTHING FALSE IN IT - which is itself worth recording after a week of slides that failed. || WHAT IS CONFIRMED: INTEL HAS RUN OVER ONE MILLION WAFERS THROUGH HIGH-NA EUV and is using it in High-Volume Manufacturing on SOME layers of Intel 18A - the FIRST chipmaker to do so. TSMC will adopt High-NA for its highest-end nodes FROM 2030, and TSMC and ASML have begun a 12-inch photomask programme with a pilot line in 2031 and production in 2033. SAMSUNG AND SK HYNIX TARGET 2028 FOR DRAM. The optical aperture rises from 0.33 on the NXE to 0.55 on the EXE; the TWINSCAN EXE:5200B resolves about 8 nanometres with imaging contrast roughly 40% above NXE. || ⚠️⚠️ THE ECONOMICS CUT BOTH WAYS AND THE SLIDE-READER USUALLY MISSES IT. A HIGH-NA MACHINE COSTS ABOUT 400 MILLION DOLLARS AGAINST ABOUT 200 MILLION FOR CURRENT EUV - TWICE THE PRICE. That is good for revenue per unit and BAD for unit volume, because a customer buying one High-NA tool may be deferring two NXE tools. ASML earns more per machine and ships fewer machines, and which effect dominates is an empirical question the company has not answered. ⚠️ ONLY ABOUT TEN HIGH-NA SYSTEMS ARE PLANNED FOR 2027 DELIVERY, TO INTEL, SAMSUNG AND SK HYNIX. This is not yet a volume product. || ⚠️⚠️ AND THE REAL TECHNICAL LIMITATION, WHICH THE ARTICLE CORRECTLY STATES AND WHICH IS THE SHARPEST THING ON THE PAGE: HIGH-NA HAS A SMALLER EXPOSURE FIELD THAN NXE. It prints a smaller area per shot. THAT MAKES IT AWKWARD FOR EXACTLY THE CHIPS THE AI BOOM NEEDS - large datacentre processors and AI accelerators are BIG dies, and a smaller field means stitching or splitting them. ASML and the chipmakers are developing larger photomasks precisely to solve this, which is why the 12-inch mask programme runs to 2033. SO HIGH-NA ARRIVES FIRST FOR SMALLER, DENSER LOGIC AND FOR DRAM - NOT FIRST FOR THE BIGGEST AI ACCELERATORS. || 💡 THE CAPACITY NUMBER IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS TO US: ASML CAN BUILD ABOUT 80 EUV MACHINES IN 2027 AND IS STUDYING WHETHER TO EXCEED 110 IN 2028 - roughly a 38% increase - AFTER SAYING 2027 CAPACITY IS CLOSE TO FULLY BOOKED. ⚠️ BUT REUTERS FRAMES THE 110 AS UNDER EVALUATION, NOT A COMMITTED TARGET, AND ASML HAS NOT CONFIRMED IT. Treat it as a demand signal, not a forecast. CFO Roger Dassen said on 15 July that 2027 EUV capacity was close to fully booked with substantial 2028 orders already secured - that IS company-sourced and is the stronger fact. || ⚠️ WHAT THE ARTICLE DOES NOT SAY, AND OUR BOARD DOES: ASML IS THE WEAKEST GROWER OF THE FOUR SEMICAP NAMES WE OWN. Our board carries revenue growth of 9.8% and a Rule of 40 of 38.4 - below the 40 bar - against LRCX at +30%, AMAT at +25% and KLAC at +15.2%. ⚠️ AND THAT FIELD NEEDS CHECKING BEFORE 15 OCTOBER: ASML reported Q2 2026 net sales of 9.3 BILLION EUROS, UP 20.8% year on year, which does not sit easily with a 9.8 figure - the difference is probably trailing-twelve-month versus quarterly, or euro versus dollar, but it must be resolved before a 7,000 tranche is placed on it. || DECISION: NO CHANGE. The 15 OCTOBER Q3 print is exactly the right place to decide rung 1 of 7,000, and the 10,000 held back deliberately stays held back. Conviction HIGH on the plan. ⚠️ WHAT I WILL READ ON 15 OCTOBER: whether ASML confirms the 2028 capacity expansion; whether High-NA units shipped are disclosed; whether the Q3 guide of 11.0 to 12.0 BILLION EUROS at a 55-57% gross margin is met; and ⚠️ whether bookings are disclosed at all, since there is an unverified report that ASML has stopped reporting quarterly bookings - if true, that removes the single best forward indicator this name has and is itself a reason to slow down.
